scene.ko: 무더운 아침 회사 탕비실에서 외국인 동료와 날씨 이야기를 하다가 고향 이야기로 대화를 이어 간다.

lines.en: Wow, it's so humid today. I'm already sweating.
lines.ko: 와, 오늘 진짜 습하네요. 벌써 땀나요.
alt: It's really humid today, isn't it? I'm sweating already.
This humidity is crazy. I'm already sweating.

lines.en: Tell me about it. And it's only June!
I know. Is it this hot in summer where you're from?
alt: Right? Are summers this hot back home?
I know! Does it get this hot where you're from?

lines.en: Not really. In Seattle, summers are mild, but it rains a lot the rest of the year.
lines.ko: 별로요. 시애틀은 여름이 선선한데, 나머지 계절엔 비가 많이 와요.

lines.en: Oh, I've always wanted to visit Seattle. Do you miss it?
lines.ko: 아, 시애틀 꼭 한번 가 보고 싶었어요. 그리워요?
alt: I've always wanted to go to Seattle! Do you miss home?

lines.en: Sometimes, especially the coffee. But I'm slowly getting used to this heat.
lines.ko: 가끔요, 특히 커피가요. 그래도 이 더위엔 조금씩 익숙해지고 있어요.

lines.en: Well, there's a great iced coffee place near the station. I'll show you sometime.
lines.ko: 그럼 역 근처에 아이스커피 맛있는 데가 있어요. 언제 한번 데려갈게요.
alt: You know, there's a really good iced coffee place by the station. I can take you there sometime.

lines.en: Deal! I'll hold you to that.

expressions.en: Is it this ___ where you're from?
expressions.note: 날씨 이야기를 상대 이야기로 넓힐 때
관심을 보여 대화를 이어 갈 때
